name: 1988 livery (pre-2018)
description: Otl Aicher's 1988 scheme as the 747-8s still wear it: white fuselage; the fin Lufthansa blue with a large yellow disc carrying the blue crane in a thin blue ring; 'Lufthansa' in blue Helvetica over the forward windows, 'lufthansa.com' small over the rear windows; a small blue crane in a ring by the cockpit; light gray engines.

sources.title: D-ABYK AIRCRAFT Boeing 747-830.jpg (CC BY-SA 4.0)
sources.note: D-ABYK right side in sun, 2025-01-23: fin, disc, titles, nose crane, all-white fuselage, gray engines. Fitted to shapes/B748-passenger.json (flipped nose-left) and probed: the disc's middle at fin (0.56, 0.48), 0.5 of the fin's height; 'lufthansa.com' x 0.715-0.793.

sources.note: D-ABYK from below-right, 2025-06-21: still in this scheme; the fin's blue and the disc.

logos.description: The pre-2018 tail: a large yellow disc with the blue Lufthansa crane (wings raised in a V, neck forward) inside a thin blue ring.
Small blue crane in a ring behind the cockpit windows.

titles.style: Helvetica Bold, Lufthansa blue, mixed case, over the forward windows.
Small lower-case web address over the rear windows, the same blue.

notes: Dark colours (checked 2026-11-27 in sun): the fin, the titles and the nose crane are one blue, a navy that reads clearly blue in sunlit photos, lighter and bluer than the 2018 scheme's Lufthansa Blue (#05164D): set by eye from D-ABYK's photos (2025-01-23, 2025-06-21) at #13286E, between the sampled fin (#08144E in the shade of a below view, #3B4066 in haze); the registration is black (not drawn). Not drawn: the small Star Alliance star by the cockpit, the type and name under the forward windows, the registration letters at the fin's tip. The passenger jets had a gray belly in earlier years; D-ABYK's is white in the 2025 photos. The title's place is from a three-quarter photo (perspective): medium.
history: Lufthansa's scheme from 1988 to 2018 (Otl Aicher's identity); most of the fleet is repainted in the 2018 scheme (DLH/standard), but some 747-8s still wear this one in 2025. Lufthansa Cargo's 777Fs wear its freighter version (GEC/standard-1988).
